mapper.select: SELECT * FROM project_script_file WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY file_type, id ASC
SELECT * FROM project_script_file WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND file_path = #{filePath}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_script_file (project_id, file_name, file_path, file_type, description, is_executable, auto_backup, create_time, update_time, tenant_id) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileType}, #{description}, #{isExecutable}, #{autoBackup}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{tenantId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM project_script_file WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
DELETE FROM project_script_file WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
